label: Heidegger shifted Husserlian phenomenological reduction from mental acts to Being-in-the-world
description: Martin Heidegger took up the concept of "Intentionality & Phenomenological Reduction (Epoché)" and systematized its implications for later thought.
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Intentionality & Phenomenological Reduction (Epoché)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis.
